messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> HIGH: p95 latency exceeded (service=inference-api, region=us-west). p95=720ms (>600ms). PD: INC-2023. Auto-escalate in 2m. https://metrics.redwood/alerts/INC-2023
ashley - oncall: acked. I'm on it, looking at dashboards now :mag:
sam - sre: seeing a spike in request queue depth on us-west hotpath, +3x over baseline. KV cache miss rate up ~18%.
maria - infra: confirmed increased eviction rate on kvcache-usw1, looks like a hot-key set from a few customers. Rolling metrics: tail latency spike correlates with large batch inference jobs from pool:dense-spot.
ashley - oncall: can we scale dedicated pool or temporarily route traffic?
sam - sre: recommend two steps: 1) scale up dedicated dense GPU pool by +2 nodes, 2) route 25% of new traffic to eu-west fallback while warmup happens.
maria - infra: running `/run cluster.scale --pool dense-gpu-usw1 --count +2` now. ETA ~90s for containers to join. Also increasing kvcache size on nodes by +10% as a stopgap.
incident-bot: cluster.scale job started (job-id: js-8821). Watch: https://ci.redwood/scale/js-8821
kevin - support: any immediate customer-facing impact? do we need to notify?
ashley - oncall: quick check: 5xxs are stable, errors not spiking. But interactive customers will see slower responses (chat latency up). Top 5 customers show p95 degraded ~30-40% in us-west. No data loss.
sam - sre: scale finished; nodes healthy. Observability: queue depth dropping, p95 down to ~430ms, still above SLO.
maria - infra: applying routing patch to send 25% to eu-west. Patch: `route-policy set inference-api region=us-west fallback=eu-west weight=25`
incident-bot: route-policy change applied (change-id: rp-440).
sam - sre: after routing, us-west p95=360ms, overall p95=280ms. KV miss rate falling. Looks like hot-key clients were causing local contention.
kevin - support: recommend a short customer note to affected customers: "We observed increased latency in us-west; we've redistributed traffic and added capacity. No data loss; follow-up postmortem to come." Want me to draft?
ashley - oncall: pls draft, keep it small. I'll resolve the page once PD is acknowledged and metrics are stable for 15m.
maria - infra: created temporary firewall rule to rate-limit the identified heavy keyset to protect kvcache-hotpath (rule: fw-939).
sam - sre: suggest we create a canary to detect recurrence: alert if queue depth > 2.5x baseline AND p95>500ms for 5m.
ashley - oncall: setting PD snooze for 15m to avoid noisy re-paging while we watch.
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> ACK recorded by ashley - oncall. Snooze set 15m.
kevin - support: drafted customer blurb and sending to ops-comm for quick review.
ashley - oncall: monitoring: at +10m p95 overall 260ms, us-west 310ms, queue depth stable. We'll keep this thread open for the postmortem checklist.
sam - sre: note for postmortem: investigate kvcache eviction policy and batch job admission controls.
maria - infra: I'll follow up with a longer-term plan: smarter hotkey throttles + prioritized kvcache segmenting.
ashley - oncall: closing PD now. I'll file incident ticket INC-2023 in tracker and assign owners for follow-up. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
